title: USDKG launches with first 50 million token issuance
description: USDKG official material records the launch of the Kyrgyz Republic state-supervised gold-backed USD stablecoin and first issuance of 50,000,000 USDKG tokens.
notes: Official USDKG material identifies OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer and states the first tokens were live on TRON.

title: AllUnity launches EURAU
description: AllUnity announced the launch of EURAU as Germany's first fully reserved MiCAR-compliant euro stablecoin following its BaFin EMI licence.
notes: The official announcement states 100% reserve backing and an institutional distribution focus.

title: Banking Circle launches EURI
description: Banking Circle announced EURI as a bank-backed MiCA-compliant euro stablecoin and electronic-money token.
notes: Issuer identity and MiCA status are established by Banking Circle.

title: Quantoz begins issuing EURQ
description: Quantoz Payments announced the start of issuance of EURQ, a euro-referenced MiCAR-compliant electronic-money token, on Ethereum.
notes: Quantoz Payments B.V. is the issuer and DNB-authorised EMI.

title: Quantoz begins issuing USDQ
description: Quantoz Payments announced the start of issuance of USDQ, a U.S.-dollar-referenced MiCAR-compliant electronic-money token, on Ethereum.
notes: Quantoz Payments B.V. is the issuer and DNB-authorised EMI.
